Elder.description: The wise, aged leader of the Starting Village.

Blacksmith.description: A burly, kind-hearted artisan who mends tools and weapons.

Fairy.description: A small, mischievous sprite of the woods who offers guidance.

Goblin.description: A small, green-skinned creature known for petty theft and ambush.

GiantSpider.description: A massive, venomous arachnid that preys on travelers in the hills.

DarkWizard.description: The powerful, malevolent sorcerer who dwells at the top of the tower.

WanderingTrader.description: A charismatic merchant with a cart full of curiosities. He speaks fast and loves gold. He is currently shouting about a high-quality rope he has for sale.

Pickpocket.description: A shadowy figure lurking behind the stalls, waiting for a distracted traveler to steal from.

Fisherman.description: A silent, weathered old man staring endlessly into the foggy waters. He knows the legends of the lake but rarely speaks.

WaterSpirit.description: A translucent entity formed from the mist and water. It guards the island in the lake and lashes out at those who disturb the peace.

SkeletonWarrior.description: An animated pile of bones wearing rusted armor. It mindlessly attacks anything living that enters the crypt.

Ghost.description: A sorrowful phantom that drifts through walls. Its touch freezes the blood, and it wails for its lost life.

CrystalGolem.description: A massive construct made of living rock and pulsing blue crystals. It stands perfectly still until someone tries to take the gems.
